summary.result: The fluoride removal by red mud was greater in seawater than deionized water, resulting from the presence of calcium and magnesium ion in seawater.
summary.background: The present study was conducted to investigate the adsorption potential of red mud for fluoride removal.
summary.method: Equilibrium sorption data were described well by Langmuir model and the maximum adsorption capacity of red mud was 5.28 mg/g.
